newsitem.title: USA: Baker, Fentress Q1 net asset value rises.
newsitem.headline: Baker, Fentress Q1 net asset value rises.

text.p: Baker, Fentress & Co said Thursday its total net assets as of March 31 rose to $742.3 million from $631.5 million a year ago.
Per-share net asset value was $21.80, down from $22.93 based on 34.0 million average shares outstanding compared with 27.5 million average shares outstanding in the same 1996 period.

Net investment income rose to $4.6 million or $0.14 per share from $2.5 million or $0.09 per share. All 1997 per-share data is after $1.78 in net long-term capital gain distribution was paid in December 1996.
Baker, Fentress, a closed-end fund, also said its directors declared a mid-year dividend of $0.20 per share on its common stock, payable June 6 to holders of record May 15.

It said it would maintain its policy of annually paying dividends and capital gain distributions which, when added together, equal at least eight percent of the company's average net asset value for the 12-month period ended October 31 of that year.
